instruction: Export the presentation to PDF format with the filename presentation.pdf and save it to the Documents folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the presentation (17 slides) to PDF format and saving to Documents folder. Evaluator checks if PDF exists and has at least 15 pages (allowing some tolerance for export variations).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: PDF file exists at specified location (/home/user/Documents/presentation.pdf), file is valid PDF format, and has sufficient pages
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts the PDF file from VM filesystem at the exact path specified in instruction
Metric (check_pdf_exists__675930f3) correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (expected.get('min_pages')) - this is the correct pattern for type='rule'
Expected value (min_pages: 15) is semantically correct for a 17-slide presentation, providing reasonable tolerance for export variations
Edge cases handled appropriately: missing file returns 0.0, invalid PDF returns 0.0, insufficient pages returns 0.0
Complete coverage: all aspects of the instruction are verified (location, filename, format, content validity)
